texts.orig: Remark 4. The mean number of waiting customers in the system is not affected by the arrival location distribution. Using Eliazar's limit argument (Eliazar, 2005), this is a consequence of the pseudo-conservation law for discrete polling models, cf. Equation (3.21) of Boxma (1989), stating that the weighted (by load of queue) sum of expected waiting times is indifferent to the arrival location distribution, λ i / ( ∑ j λ j ) .
